title: Changes in Ischemia and Angina Over 1 Year Among ISCHEMIA Trial Screen Failures With no Obstructive CAD on Coronary CT Angiography
brief_summary: Serial assessment of angina status and ischemia on stress echo over one year among patients with moderate ischemia on stress imaging and non-obstructive CAD on coronary CT angiography.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Enrolled but not randomized in ISCHEMIA trial
* Stress echocardiography used for enrollment\*
* No obstructive CAD on study coronary CT angiography (defined as no ≥50% stenosis in a major epicardial vessel)
* Ischemic symptoms (chest pain or other potential ischemic equivalent).
* Participant is willing to give written informed consent
* Age ≥ 21 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* Inability to comply with protocol
* Prior PCI or CABG
